questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Exhausted permutit does not contain.......ion
questions.solution: Permutit or zeolite is the aluminosilicate of sodium. It is used to remove hardness of water. It converts insoluble salts of $\mathrm{Ca}^{2+}$ and $\mathrm{Mg}^{2+}$ into soluble zeolites. It exchange these ions with $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$ and water becomes soft. Thus exhausted permutit does not contain $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$ ions.
